description: Flat metadata schema for individual coastal sediment samples analyzed by high-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing, including spatial, temporal, environmental, and sequencing context.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample/record.

site_name.descr: Name of the coastal sampling location or station.

location_description.descr: Free-text description of the site, including habitat context if relevant.

latitude_dd.descr: Latitude in decimal degrees; WGS84 recommended. Example: 34.12345.

longitude_dd.descr: Longitude in decimal degrees; WGS84 recommended. Example: -118.12345.

geographic_region.descr: Broader region or administrative area for the site, such as bay, estuary, province, or country.

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

sampling_time.descr: Local time of sample collection in HH:MM[:SS] if available.

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; use a project-consistent category such as spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter.

tidal_state.descr: Tidal condition at collection time if known; e.g., high tide, low tide, ebb, flood, unknown.

sample_depth_cm.descr: Sediment depth interval sampled, in centimeters below the sediment surface.

water_depth_m.descr: Water depth at the sampling location, in meters, if measured.

temperature_c.descr: Environmental temperature at sampling, in degrees Celsius.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity of the overlying water or porewater, in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: Measured pH of sediment porewater or overlying water, if available.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in mg/L, if measured.

sediment_type.descr: Sediment texture or classification; e.g., sandy, muddy, silty, clayey, mixed.

grain_size_description.descr: Free-text or categorical summary of grain size distribution or dominant particle size.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Percent organic matter in the sediment, if measured.

redox_potential_mv.descr: Redox potential in millivolts, if measured.

nutrient_nitrate_umol_l.descr: Nitrate concentration in micromolar (µmol/L), if measured.

nutrient_ammonium_umol_l.descr: Ammonium concentration in micromolar (µmol/L), if measured.

nutrient_phosphate_umol_l.descr: Phosphate concentration in micromolar (µmol/L), if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_g.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration normalized to sediment mass, in µg/g, if measured.

site_vegetation.descr: Dominant adjacent vegetation or habitat cover, such as mangrove, marsh grass, seagrass, bare sediment, or none.

anthropogenic_influence.descr: Indicator of human impact at the site; e.g., pristine, urban, industrial, agricultural, mixed, unknown.

sample_replicate_id.descr: Replicate identifier within a site and timepoint, if applicable.

collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the sediment sample; e.g., corer, grab, shovel, syringe, other.

preservation_method.descr: How the sample was preserved prior to DNA extraction; e.g., frozen at -20C, frozen at -80C, RNAlater, ethanol, dry ice.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature prior to DNA extraction, in degrees Celsius.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used.

marker_gene.descr: Target marker gene; for this dataset typically 16S rRNA gene.

target_region.descr: Amplified 16S rRNA region, such as V3-V4, V4, V4-V5, or other specified region.

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, Ion Torrent.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs for the sequencing run, if applicable.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for amplicon sequencing.

bioinformatic_pipeline.descr: Name and version of the bioinformatic pipeline used for sequence processing, if known.

quality_filtering_criteria.descr: Free-text summary of read filtering and trimming criteria used during processing.

sample_notes.descr: Additional comments or observations relevant to the sample record.
